items.title: Join Docker Verified Publisher through self-service plans
items.description: Apply for DVP Starter or Growth, complete checkout after approval, and manage publisher analytics, tracked companies, and billing.

items.title: Sign and enforce trusted sandbox kits
items.description: Sign kits with cosign-compatible Sigstore signatures, verify keyless or key-based signatures, and reject kits outside a trusted-signer policy.

items.title: Define reproducible sandbox environments
items.description: Capture an agent, workspaces, kits, credentials, ports, and resources in a shareable .sbxenv.yaml file and manage it with sbx env.

items.title: Resolve sandbox secrets from external sources
items.description: Keep references to 1Password, AWS Secrets Manager, or host commands in the secret store and resolve credentials on the host when the proxy needs them.

items.title: Run GPU workloads in sandboxes
items.description: Pass an NVIDIA GPU through to a sandbox on supported Linux hosts for GPU-accelerated agent workloads.

items.title: Query DHI VEX data with the GraphQL API
items.description: Build automation or dashboards that query image packages, CVEs, VEX statements, and suppressed vulnerabilities by digest.

items.title: Use Docker VMM on Mac and Windows
items.description: Run Docker Desktop with Docker's container-optimized hypervisor on supported Mac and Windows systems.

items.title: Connect sandboxes through an MCP gateway
items.description: Register local or remote MCP servers on the host, reuse them across sandboxes, and govern server and tool access with Cedar policies.

items.title: Author version 2 sandbox kits
items.description: Define kit setup, permissions, networking, and API key or OAuth credential requirements with the version 2 kit schema.

items.title: Run Claude Code with local models
items.description: Route Claude Code sandbox requests to the bundled local-model server or an existing Ollama installation.

items.title: Search and forward audit events
items.description: Search and export policy decisions from Docker Cloud, or forward events to Splunk Cloud, Dynatrace, and Datadog.

items.title: Install from the Microsoft Store without administrator privileges
items.description: Fresh Microsoft Store installations on Windows use per-user mode by default.

items.title: Share agent skills across sandboxes
items.description: Import skills from supported host agents into a persistent store that sandboxes can share.

items.title: Connect editors and desktop apps over SSH
items.description: Use a sandbox from VS Code, Cursor, Claude Desktop, ChatGPT, or another SSH-capable tool.
